title: Link document
description: What `recon link` produced: the relinked image, and how much of it is reconstructed code rather than bytes carried over from the original.

pieces.description: How many pieces the delink plan cut the original into.

rebuilt.description: How many of those pieces a unit claims to provide rather than the original's bytes.

rebuilt_pieces.description: The pieces actually filled from a unit's own build. A claim is not a supply: a unit can claim a piece and have nothing that fits it, and the difference is what this says.

piece.description: The plan's id for the piece that was filled.

unit.description: The unit whose build filled it.

source.description: That unit's source, as the project names it.

bytes.description: How many bytes of the unit's compiled function were placed.

references.description: Addresses inside the rebuild emitted as references to names the image defines.

original_bytes_kept.description: Bytes of the original kept after the rebuild, when the rebuild is shorter than the space the original used.

problems.description: Why a claimed piece kept the original's bytes: no object, a stale object, a name the object does not define, a rebuild that does not fit, or a reference the relinked image cannot name.
